title: Kenyan Passion Fruit Curry
description: A unique and flavorful curry dish that combines the sweetness of passion fruit with the spices of Kenya. This hearty and velvety curry is perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: Curry powder
ingredients.notes: Use a mix of turmeric, coriander, and cumin powder

ingredients.name: Coconut milk
ingredients.notes: Full-fat coconut milk for a rich and creamy curry

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Use 2-3 cloves for a stronger flavor

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.notes: Use 2-3 carrots for a more vibrant color

ingredients.name: Tomato paste
ingredients.notes: Use a high-quality tomato paste for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for a more complex flavor

ingredients.name: Black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a freshly ground black pepper for a more intense flavor

ingredients.name: Fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Use fresh cilantro for the best flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped carrots and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the tomato paste and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and let the curry simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the carrots are tender.
Stir in the chopped passion fruit and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve over rice or with naan bread.
